title: Music player
summary: Recreate a player card: gradient album art with a frosted label, a truncated title, progress bar and a round play button.
brief: The card is dark (#18181b) with 20px rounded corners and white text. The album art is 260px tall with 14px corners, painted with a pink glow at 30% 30%, a violet glow at 70% 70% (each fading out by 50%) over a 135deg orange-to-violet gradient (#f97316 to #7c3aed).
A frosted label sits 12px inside the bottom of the art: 10px 12px padding, 10px corners, a 20% white background blurring what is behind it, extra bold text spaced 0.3em.

Below, 16px down: the title (16px, semibold) stays on one line and ends in an ellipsis; the artist is 13px #a1a1aa. Then, 16px down, a 4px round progress track (#3f3f46) filled 36% in orange, with the two times (11px grey, tabular digits) at either end 6px below it.

The controls row is 12px further down, centred, 24px apart: two #e4e4e7 skip buttons and a 56px orange play button with an orange glow and a white triangle drawn in CSS (16 × 18px, 19px from the top and 22px from the left).
hints: Work top to bottom. The art is position: relative so the label can be absolute with left, right and bottom at 12px. Several gradients go into one background-image, separated by commas; the first is drawn on top. The frosting is backdrop-filter: blur(10px).
The title needs white-space: nowrap, overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis. The progress track has overflow: hidden and the fill inside is width: 36%, height: 100%.

The triangle is .play::before with content: "", position: absolute and clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 50%, 0 100%); .play needs position: relative. The glow is box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgb(249 115 22 / 0.45).

children.text: Midnight drive through an empty city by the sea

solutionNotes: Nothing here is new on its own; the challenge is combining it. The art is a stack of gradients (the radial glows fade to transparent so the linear gradient shows between them), and backdrop-filter frosts only the label because only the label has a see-through background. The title truncates because all three properties are present: nowrap keeps one line, overflow hides the rest, text-overflow draws the dots. The progress bar is a track with a child whose width is the progress. The play icon is a pseudo-element clipped to a triangle, nudged right of centre so it looks centred, since a triangle’s visual weight sits on its flat side.
